episode_summary: This episode explores the impact of AI and industry consolidation on real estate agents. Chris Linsell emphasizes the importance of building a personal brand independent of brokerage affiliations and offers strategies for increasing visibility in AI-generated searches. The discussion also covers the implications of recent mergers and acquisitions in the real estate industry.
